releases.title: HAF Bot is now open source
releases.summary: HAF Bot's source is now public under the MIT license. Explore the code, contribute improvements, or run HAF on your own infrastructure.

changes.text: Read the source, report issues and contribute at https://github.com/rogersau/hafbot.
Self-host with Docker, PostgreSQL and your own Discord application. Follow https://docs.hafbot.xyz/self-hosting for setup requirements and current installation limits.
Hosted HAF remains available with the same dashboard, features and subscription plans.

releases.title: Standard subscription pricing
releases.summary: Premium and Premium Plus now use our standard subscription prices for new and returning subscribers.

changes.text: Premium is AU$4.99 per month or AU$45 per year. Premium Plus is AU$8.99 per month or AU$80 per year.
New and returning subscribers can choose the current prices. Existing subscriptions keep their current Stripe price unless their owner chooses a change.

releases.title: Server Levels beta
releases.summary: Server Levels is now available for Premium servers. Connect your DayZ servers with CFTools and give members more Server XP for playing while the server is quiet.

changes.text: Add up to five DayZ servers from the admin dashboard.
Members can check their level and the leaderboard with /serverlevel.
Set a channel for level-up messages if you want them.

releases.title: Bring additional participants into Tickets
releases.summary: Support teams can now invite another Guild member into an active Ticket when extra context or collaboration is needed, without exposing which staff member granted access.

changes.text: Enable staff-managed participants separately for each Ticket type from the admin dashboard.
Use /ticket add-user and /ticket remove-user inside an active Ticket to safely grant or revoke a Guild member's access.
Keep participant notifications neutral while retaining a staff-visible access history in the Ticket transcript for accountability.
Optionally require members to relink Player Link accounts after leaving and rejoining, while retaining their existing account records as inactive.

releases.title: Introducing Suggestions and the Operations Inbox
releases.summary: Communities can now collect structured suggestions while Guild admins can see important automation problems in one place and take the next safe action from the Guild overview.

changes.text: Configure Suggestions from the admin dashboard, then publish a permanent panel that guides members through structured proposals in a Discord Forum.
Help members improve proposals with duplicate warnings, configurable categories and questions, author revisions, and Considered Replies.
Let eligible members privately Support or Oppose a Suggestion while showing only aggregate participation totals to the community.
Move Suggestions through its review lifecycle with a written staff outcome for every final decision.
See an Operations Inbox when a scheduled Managed Message fails, a published message disappears, a Webhook destination repeatedly fails, or a Player Count server goes offline.
Review each problem's affected feature, severity, timing, impact, and recommended next step without exposing provider errors or credentials.
Suggestions includes guided resource setup, readiness checks, and repair tools, while Guild admins with write access can retry eligible Managed Message and Player Count operations directly.

releases.title: Clan Management is now in beta
releases.summary: Guilds can now create and manage Clans through a guided Discord workflow. This feature is in beta, and we would love your feedback in the HAF Bot Discord.

changes.text: Configure Clan eligibility, reviewer roles, managed Discord resources, recruitment, and lifecycle settings from the Clan Management dashboard.
Publish a customizable Clan creation panel where members can submit requests without learning a slash command.
Review each request with the applicant in a private Discord ticket using Approve, Request changes, and Reject actions.
Recover interrupted Clan provisioning and lifecycle work automatically while keeping Clan history and audit events consistent.
Clan Management is a beta feature. Share feedback with us at https://discord.gg/HpRPkdm6dv.

releases.title: More reliable Tickets and managed storage
releases.summary: Guild admins can now see managed-storage usage at a glance, while Ticket recovery and background processing are more resilient to temporary failures.

changes.text: View stored, temporarily reserved, and total managed-storage usage from the Guild overview.
Recover incomplete Ticket creation, closure, panel publication, and template-reply operations automatically after temporary Discord failures.
Process failed background jobs independently so one problem is less likely to delay unrelated moderation, webhook, storage, or Platform Link activity.
Prevent duplicate processing when Discord gateway events are delivered more than once.

releases.title: Reuse embed templates across messages and Tickets
releases.summary: Guild admins can save polished embed layouts once, then reuse them for Managed Messages and consistent Ticket replies.

changes.text: Create, edit, duplicate, and reuse Guild-wide embed templates from the Managed Messages dashboard.
Send approved template replies from a Ticket or Staff Discussion Thread with autocomplete and a private preview before sending.

releases.title: Better Ticket workflows and custom panel colours
releases.summary: Guild staff can review and respond to Tickets more reliably, while admins gain more control over the appearance and privacy of their Discord panels.

changes.text: View a member's Ticket History from Discord, including links to open Tickets and available transcripts.
Staff Discussion Thread messages now remain private by default. When Anonymous Support is enabled, use !send to publish a response to the member.
Choose custom embed colours for Ticket, LFG Noticeboard, and Player Link panels.
Fixed an issue that could cause an Anonymous Support response to appear twice in a Ticket.

releases.title: Turnstile verification is now available
releases.summary: Premium and Premium Plus communities can add a Turnstile challenge to Member Verification before members receive their verified role.

changes.text: Choose Turnstile as the verification method for Welcome DMs or Welcome Panels, giving new members a simple challenge before HAF grants access.

releases.title: Draft and schedule Managed Messages
releases.summary: Guild admins can prepare Managed Messages without publishing immediately and schedule one future publication.

changes.text: Save Managed Message drafts without creating a Discord message, then publish immediately or schedule a one-time future publication.
Edit, reschedule, or cancel scheduled drafts while ensuring the latest saved content is published at the chosen time.

releases.title: More automatic responses for Bot Defense
releases.summary: Guild admins can now choose how each Bot Defense detector responds when suspicious message activity is detected.

changes.text: Configure the Honeypot Detector and Rate Detector independently to warn the member, delete the triggering message, do both, or only raise a flag.
Apply each detector's selected response on every trip, including while the member already has an open Bot Defense flag.
Retry temporary Discord failures safely without repeatedly retrying permanent permission errors.

releases.title: More control over audit logs and messages
releases.summary: Guild admins can reduce expected Discord noise in the audit log and format Managed Messages more easily.

changes.text: Exclude selected channels or member roles from eligible Discord audit events while keeping HAF activity and protected lifecycle events visible.
Apply channel exclusions to threads and Forum posts through their parent channel, and record every exclusion-policy change in the audit log.
Format Managed Message embed descriptions with the Markdown toolbar and preview without exceeding Discord's description limit.

releases.title: Introducing Managed Messages
releases.summary: Publish polished, bot-authored information messages and keep them up to date from the admin dashboard.

changes.text: Build messages with multiple Discord embeds, fields, colours, images, and live previews.
Publish to a server channel, optionally notify selected roles, and edit or remove the message later.
See when a published message has been removed from Discord and repair it from the admin dashboard.
Record Managed Message creation, updates, repairs, and deletion in the Guild Audit Log.

releases.title: Introducing Mention Protection
releases.summary: Paid-plan communities can now protect selected staff and respond consistently to direct-user mention spam.

changes.text: Enable Admin Mention Protection and Mention Spam Protection independently with shared channel scope and role exclusions.
Configure initial and repeat warnings, message deletion, Discord timeouts, or Timed Role restrictions.
Record every Mention Protection deletion in the Guild Audit Log without requiring an Audit Destination.

releases.title: Discord previews now match published messages
releases.summary: Discord message previews in the admin dashboard now provide a more accurate representation of what members will see after a message is published.

changes.text: Render Discord Markdown correctly in preview descriptions, message content, and embed fields.
Match production embed colours, buttons, emojis, fields, footers, and plain-message fallbacks across feature previews.
Remove unsupported formatting controls from embed title editors.

releases.title: Introducing Bot Defense
releases.summary: Bot Defense gives paid-plan communities a review-first way to spot suspicious accounts without handing enforcement decisions to automation.

changes.text: Detect suspicious accounts with configurable honeypot and cross-channel rate signals.
Set up a recommended #do-not-post honeypot channel directly from the admin dashboard.
Send evidence-backed flags to a staff queue where authorized reviewers can confirm or dismiss them.
Keep enforcement in staff hands: confirmed flags are recorded but never automatically ban, kick, or change a member's roles.

releases.title: Introducing Events
releases.summary: The first version of Events brings scheduled activities and Discord-native signups to HAF Bot communities.

changes.text: Create, schedule, and publish Events from the admin dashboard.
Build flexible rosters with Signup Groups, capacity limits, automatic waitlists, and role eligibility.
Let members join from one Discord message, with event times shown in their own timezone.
Keep attendees informed with optional Event Threads and configurable reminders.
